c:
docker compose up -d
docker compose ps
q: What does the status column say once it is ready, and which host port is used?
why: The healthcheck says healthy when Postgres accepts connections. The host port is 5433, so it does not clash with a Postgres on 5432.

c: SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'vector';
q: What does a ready database answer?
why: init.sql turned the extension on when the database was created.

c: SELECT name, embedding <-> '[1, 0.05, 0]' AS distance FROM items ORDER BY embedding <-> '[1, 0.05, 0]' LIMIT 3;
q: Which item comes first, and is a smaller distance closer or further?
o: hot, and a smaller distance is closer
battery, and a smaller distance is further
why: Distance is a measure of how far apart two vectors are, so smaller means closer.

c: SELECT name, 1 - (embedding <=> '[1, 0.05, 0]') AS cosine_similarity FROM items ORDER BY embedding <=> '[1, 0.05, 0]' LIMIT 3;
q: How do you read this number?
o: Bigger means closer (1 is the same direction)
why: 1 - cosine distance is the cosine similarity from Day 37. You still sort by the distance, ascending.

c: INSERT INTO items (name, embedding) VALUES ('wrong size', '[1, 2]');   -- the column is vector(3)
o: It pads the vector with a zero
why: The dimension check protects you from mixing vectors of two different models.

q: What happens in a brand new database?
o: ERROR: type "vector" does not exist: the extension is not on there
why: init.sql only ran for the first database. In another one, run CREATE EXTENSION vector;
